question: What kind of person is condemned as a mockery of the Kula teaching?
premises: Such a person is always fickle.
This behavior is called a mockery of Kula scripture.
inference: One who pursues the practice out of greed and fickleness makes a mockery of Kula scripture.
uncertainties: The grammatical agreement of capalā with the subject is contextually flexible.
plain_english: A greedy, always fickle seeker is a mockery of the Kula scripture.
